# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews the Skia m156 renderer and expands support for GTK4, Tizen 10, and .NET 11. It adds native GTK4 GPU rendering, updates platform and WebAssembly build assets, and restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments.

## Breaking Changes

- **Tizen 8 and 9 are no longer supported** — Tizen native assets and package targets now require Tizen 10. Update Tizen applications and device-test manifests to target Tizen 10 before upgrading. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **High-density GTK4 drawing uses physical pixels by default** — SKDrawingArea now creates physical-pixel backing surfaces on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true when an existing application requires logical paint coordinates. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Updates the bundled renderer to the m156 engine line while preserving the existing managed API surface. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))
- **Skia fork cleanup integrated** — Aligns the bundled m155 native sources more closely with upstream while retaining compatibility required by supported toolchains. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## API Surface

- **GTK4 gains a GPU-backed drawing control** — SKGLArea provides a GTK-owned OpenGL Skia canvas with paint events, render-loop control, and explicit physical or logical pixel behavior. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies finds installed system fonts** — The no-fontconfig Linux native package again discovers fonts from the configured system font directory, restoring family-based font matching. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly assets are aligned with the preview toolchain** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp packages select matching WebAssembly archives for .NET 11 and later, avoiding a stale toolchain selection. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))
- **Tizen 10 with GCC 14.2 is the supported native baseline** — Tizen x64 and arm64 native assets now target Tizen 10 and its GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 accompanies the m156 line with the aligned WebAssembly assets, Tizen baseline, and Linux font-discovery support.
